_comment: The exact REMORA core artifacts this product build consumes. AAE never installs from REMORA master and never imports internal REMORA modules; it pins this set and verifies every hash before use.
release_status_reason: Supersedes core-candidate-2026.08.05.2, which refused a changed ToolSpec only AFTER authorizing — leaving a dispatch intent behind for a call that was never allowed. Still a prerelease: no external review has run against this build and Gate B is not closed. Pinnable, not blessed.
